verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk operation that acts across many flags, experiments or metrics at once. The toggle endpoint switches a single flag across one or more environments, and draft publishing batches changes to a single feature; both are adjacent behaviors, not multi-item bulk actions. The REST API and MCP server are only building blocks a user could script against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
